findings.issue: Only the root half of the stability API gets a directly usable lemma. `dividedPower_smul_mem_admissibleLattice` names the `eᵢ⁽ⁿ⁾` case, but there is no counterpart for the Cartan generators `Ring.choose (ι ℚ (h i)) n`, even though `generator_smul_mem_admissibleLattice` (line 114) proves both cases and `Kostant/Form.lean` develops the two families symmetrically (`dividedPower_mem_kostantForm`:155 / `ringChoose_mem_kostantForm`:161, `rootVector_mem_kostantForm`:167 / `cartanVector_mem_kostantForm`:172). The torus half of the Chevalley–Demazure construction the PR description targets needs exactly the missing form, and reaching it through `generator_smul_mem_admissibleLattice` forces the consumer to build a `kostantGenerators` membership by hand.

findings.evidence: AdmissibleLattice.lean:24-26 ("both are proved here": stability and fullness) contradicts AdmissibleLattice.lean:30-31 ("deliberately *not* claimed is that `V_ℤ` is a finitely generated `ℤ`-module"); the file contains no finiteness or freeness statement (`grep -n "Finite\|Free" AdmissibleLattice.lean` is empty).
findings.fix: Reword line 24 to state what is actually proved — that `V_ℤ` is `U_ℤ`-stable and full — and say plainly that "lattice" is provisional until finite generation is available, instead of claiming the name is earned. (Renaming to something like `kostantOrbit` would also resolve it, but a corrected docstring suffices for this angle.)
findings.issue: The module docstring asserts "Two things have to be true for `V_ℤ` to deserve the name, and both are proved here", listing stability and fullness. Neither implies that `V_ℤ` is a lattice: that requires finite generation / `ℤ`-freeness, which lines 30-34 of the same docstring explicitly disclaim as unproved pending integral PBW. A reader of the public `admissibleLattice` name and its documentation is told the object has been certified as a lattice when the file proves only that it is a full, `U_ℤ`-stable subgroup.

summary: The surface is minimal and bodies are unexposed, but the stability API is developed on only one of the two generator families, and the module docstring claims the name `lattice` is earned by properties that do not establish it. Both are one-line fixes.
